name: qfd_coll_split_q11b-q11b-COMMIT
purpose: FALLBACK of q11a (SQC-CTL 10-21): q11a's same-edge SRAM/control/read-capture + stage-local reset clock neighbourhoods (tools/qwen_cluster/q11_pair/clock_pair.tcl, OT_SPINE_TOL_PS 10) applied to the q10b FALLBACK geometry 239.76x285.12 (central 30-um W-E band, halo 8.64, W/E pins 1.87/um). Fixes the q9b/q10a/q10b route classes: TT SRAM->out setup (rclk 82 ps late), FF counter->SRAM addr hold (85 ps), reset removal (68 ps). Exact q10 RTL, pins, constraints; zero cycles.
